## Summary

**Problem:** checkout-api was failing health checks after the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions, with an error rate of 0.18.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Investigated** — `get_service_status` confirmed v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Deployment history showed v2.3.0 (seq 1) was the most recent release that was healthy in production; v2.3.1 (seq 3) was unhealthy, and v2.3.1-rc was only a staging build.

3. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) for checkout-api describing the failure and the rollback. The initial call timed out, but the incident was created successfully.

**Final state:** checkout-api is now on v2.3.0 in all regions, healthy, with error rate back down to 0.002. Incident INC-0001 is open to track the issue.
